narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with low pressure and a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and southeast Virginia.
ev: Lakeside Avenue was closed at Brook Avenue due to flooding.
One lane of northbound Route 250 was impassable due to water on roadway.
Route 157 (Pemberton Road) was partially closed at Downing Street due to water on roadway.
Beaverdam Road was closed at Hollybush Road due to water on the roadway.
Route 460 was closed near Cox Road due to flooding. Several other smaller roads were reported closed also due to flooding.
